name: Torremocha del Pinar (Spain)
description: Vertically divided white and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Torremocha del Pinar (a tower and pines on green and white).
history: Municipal flag of Torremocha del Pinar; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Torremocha del Pinar arms — tower and pines
